exposure: Time of birth (office hours vs. outside office hours)
Mode of delivery (vaginal, vaginal breech, instrumental vaginal, elective Cesarean, non-elective Cesarean)
cohort: Singleton term hospital births in Finland from 2005 to 2009
finding: Babies born outside office hours are at higher risk for adverse outcomes, including low Apgar scores, low umbilical artery pH, and increased intrapartum and early neonatal mortality in large, non-university hospitals.
mod_finding: Instrumental vaginal delivery outside of office hours was associated with an increased risk of mortality.
